scope: Assistant text-only audit of source/published transcript pairs before any new candidate inference. No audio rehearing, independent intent rating, new ASR or LLM inference.
keyLimitations: Published references contain apparent artifacts; context-free ASR contains truncations, omitted names/numerals and altered negation. Never feed reference to model or claim exact-reference recovery as grounded contextual repair. These historical public read-speech regressions are not held-out spontaneous dictation.
